selection_note: Hindsight-selected development case (not a sealed holdout), taken from an unverified lead (Gruyere - APA microgrid). Timestamps are date-only because Gold Road is now delisted and its ASX announcement listing is unavailable.

lead_time.note: UNVERIFIED: the earliest signal (PFS date) and the target are date-only printed values (PRINTED_DATE_ONLY). Indicative only (not a lead time): 2016-02-08 to the 2016-08-01 update is about 175 days, but the RFT itself was issued in March 2016 (about 1 month after the PFS), and the public learned of it only through the Aug 2016 update. The later APA award (ASX 21/06/2017 08:30 +10:00, agent-asserted) is about 324 days after the Aug 2016 update and about 15 months after the RFT.

blockers: All signals and the target are PRINTED_DATE_ONLY: Gold Road is delisted and the ASX announcement listing for GOR returns nothing; earliest Wayback snapshot of the PDF is 2019. No lead time is stated.
The PFS (8 Feb 2016) and the March 2016 RFT documents themselves were not captured; their dates come only from the Aug 2016 update text.
Gruyere feasibility study completion (Oct 2016) and JV formation (Nov 2016) announcements not captured.

The APA announcement is the award; the preceding 15-year transport and electricity supply agreement signing dates are not separately sourced. Gold Fields and APA appear in the buyer chain only through the later APA release (not a signal or target here), so buyer_path lists only Gold Road.

Captured Aug 2016 text contains non-breaking spaces and U+2010 hyphens exactly as in the capture.

target_fit_note: Owner-issued request for tender for a build-own-operate power supply (gas-only, diesel-only and diesel-to-gas options) for a long-life mine: long-term on-site supply, not temporary or rental power. It is a tender-stage event disclosed in a later update, not a contract award.
